name: Tobias Harbeck Frey
original_name: トビアス・ハーベック・フレイ
source:
"Someday, I will become a splendid knight like Commander Herringtail... ーGhaha!"

The head of the fallen aristocracy, the Habeck family, who has no parents or grandparents and is lonely. 

He is so sickly that he collapses after just a short walk, so he tends to be a recluse.

He is reluctant to love, to live, and to do anything, but his yearning to be a knight is stronger than anyone else's.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/tsuitsui/chara/]official website[/url]]
